_why: м-т Траката is published by epro and ViK and OSM has no place of that name — it maps the area as three neighbourhoods, Горна/Средна/Долна Трака. Средна Трака is the middle of the three, so it is the least wrong single pin for the whole locality. An alias rather than a new region row: inventing a 'Траката' row would put a fourth, made-up place beside three real ones.

ViK's own shorthand for Владиславово: it publishes 'ж.к. В -во' (and 'В -во'), which is an abbreviation no similarity measure can reach — the core 'В -во' shares no trigram with 'Владиславово'. region_aliases is exactly the mechanism for source shorthand, and both the bare and prefixed forms are listed because parseName strips the kind and the sources write it either way (the Владислав Варненчик pair above does the same).
Source shorthand for Западна промишлена зона, found in the 29.10.2026 review (9f0d8ee5, 353e9f82 batch): 'ЗПЗ' and 'З.П.З.' share no trigram with the full name, the same situation as 'В -во' above.

epro and ViK write the resort as a locality ('м-т Св. Св. Константин и Елена', 'м. …'), while OSM and the seed carry it as к.к. The kind filter keeps м-т and к.к. apart on purpose (F8 left к.к. out of the merged class), so the source's kind is listed as an alias of the one real row rather than loosening the filter (49e2953b, 52552aac).
